findingClass: one IPO stored as two rows — the same offering sharing an identifier (CIN/ISIN/symbol/BSE scrip code), a suffix-stripped slug, or a normalised name + open date
failThreshold: any group of 2+ offering_type=IPO rows sharing CIN, ISIN, symbol, BSE scrip code, a status-suffix-stripped slug, or normalised company name + same open_date
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table
note: Implements the §2.3.3.1 F-103 standing sweep (owner #903, S1/S2/S7); flags the live Rays of Belief pair on prod/staging.
